title: pellaea paupercula
intro: Pellaea paupercula, commonly known as Rock Cap Fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. It is a type of non-vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Rock Cap Fern is said to have anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pellaea paupercula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions.
